title: Walking in Fire
author: Himanshu Jena
text:
Destiny is not destined to be
the slave of circumstances
rather the commitment to walk along
the line of fire

The thorns of truth yield the roses of
contentment divine
The path of peace showers
the spring of harmony

Life is flowering to the fullest
Life is captivating to the core
When gifted with wings of incredible fire

The more one ignited,
the more one enlightened
The more diamond days flow within
and without amid many a thunderstorm.
